name: Mission Plastics
old_description: Injection molding customized to your specs, your timeline, and your expectations.
about:
Mission Plastics, headquartered in Grandview, Missouri, has specialized in custom injection molding since 1968. The company is family-owned and operated and operates as part of the Peterson Manufacturing family of businesses, which provides additional vertically integrated capabilities such as metal stamping, PCB manufacturing, and wire harness assembly.

Mission Plastics runs two facilities—in Greater Kansas City and Southwest Arkansas—totaling 198,000 square feet, including a 50,000-square-foot on-site tool shop. Its 96 injection molding machines range from 35 to 610 tons, with five vertical and three two-shot presses. The shop offers insert molding, overmolding, automation, mold design, engineering, prototyping, and turnkey manufacturing, all under ISO 9001:2015 and UL certification.

The molder serves consumer products, industrial applications, lawn and garden, and lenses and optics. Long-term customers include Milbank (cited by buyer Sarah Brown), a global manufacturer (referenced by its director of design and engineering), and a Fortune 500 company (noted by engineering manager Michael Ranta).

Mission Plastics emphasizes its family-owned culture, with many master crafters exceeding 20 years of tenure, and its financially stable, debt-free structure. Sustainability initiatives include returnable packaging systems, scrap reduction, and recycling programs aimed at reducing landfill waste.
